# ash_state_machine v0.2.13 - Table of Contents

The extension for building state machines with Ash resources.

## GUIDES

- [Home](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Tutorials
  - [Getting Started with State Machines](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/getting-started-with-ash-state-machine.md)

- Topics
  - [What is AshStateMachine?](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/what-is-ash-state-machine.md)
  - [Charts](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/charts.md)
  - [Working with Ash.can?](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/working-with-ash-can.md)

- DSLs
  - [AshStateMachine](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/dsl-ashstatemachine.md)

- About AshStateMachine
  - [Change Log](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- Dsl
  - [AshStateMachine](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/AshStateMachine.md): Provides tools for defining and working with resource-backed state machines.

- Introspection
  - [AshStateMachine.Info](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/AshStateMachine.Info.md): Introspection helpers for `AshStateMachine`
  - [AshStateMachine.Transition](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/AshStateMachine.Transition.md): The configuration for an transition.

- Helpers
  - [AshStateMachine.BuiltinChanges](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/AshStateMachine.BuiltinChanges.md): Changes for working with AshStateMachine resources.

- Charts
  - [AshStateMachine.Charts](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/AshStateMachine.Charts.md): Returns a mermaid flow chart of a given state machine resource.

- Errors
  - [AshStateMachine.Errors.InvalidInitialState](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/AshStateMachine.Errors.InvalidInitialState.md): Used when an initial state is set that is not a valid initial state
  - [AshStateMachine.Errors.NoMatchingTransition](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/AshStateMachine.Errors.NoMatchingTransition.md): Used when a state change occurs in an action with no matching transition

- Internals
  - [AshStateMachine.Checks.ValidNextState](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/AshStateMachine.Checks.ValidNextState.md): A policy for pre_flight checking if a state transition is allowed.

## Mix Tasks

- Internals
  - [mix ash_state_machine.generate_flow_charts](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshStateMachine.GenerateFlowCharts.md): Generates a Mermaid Flow Chart for each `Ash.Resource` with the `AshStateMachine`
extension alongside the resource.
  - [mix ash_state_machine.install](https://ash-state-machine.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshStateMachine.Install.md): Installs AshStateMachine
